sentences.english: It was nice talking to you.

conversation_script.text_en: I have to go now. Goodbye!

sentences.english: My full name is Kevin Ming Wang.
sentences.chinese: 我的名字是 Kevin Ming Wang。

sentences.english: My name is easy to spell.

conversation_script.text_en: Nice to meet you too, Sarah.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也很高兴见到你,萨拉。

conversation_script.text_en: What do your friends call you?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你的朋友们怎么称呼你？

sentences.english: My surname is Zhang, and my name is Zhang San.
I am Li Hua, and you?
I am also very glad to meet you.
Hello, what is your Chinese name?
sentences.chinese: 你好，你叫什么中文名字？

sentences.english: My surname is Wang, what is his surname?

conversation_script.text_en: My name is David. And you?
My name is Li Hua. What is your surname?
I am also very glad to meet you.
She is my friend. Her name is Anna.
Her Chinese name is Wang Ling.
Great, let's go say hello to her.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了，我们去跟她打个招呼吧。

sentences.english: I am from a small town.
It is a nice place to live.
sentences.chinese: 这是一个适合居住的好地方。

conversation_script.text_en: No, I live in Shanghai now.
Yes, it is a very big city.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,那是一个非常大的城市。

conversation_script.text_en: I would like to visit it someday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我希望有一天去那里参观。

sentences.chinese: 这位游客是澳大利亚人。

conversation_script.text_zh: 哦,所以你是几内亚人吗？

conversation_script.text_en: That's right. Do you know people from other countries?
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错。你认识其他国家的人吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes. My classmates are Canadian, American, and Indian.
conversation_script.text_zh: 认识。我的同学有加拿大人、美国人和印度人。

conversation_script.text_en: I have friends from France, Spain, and Korea.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有来自法国、西班牙和韩国的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, and I also know a German and an Australian.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我还认识一位德国人和一位澳大利亚人。

conversation_script.text_en: It's great to meet people from different countries.
conversation_script.text_zh: 认识来自不同国家的人真棒。

conversation_script.text_en: The world is a big place.

sentences.english: I can understand a little Chinese.

sentences.chinese: 让我们一起练习英语吧。

sentences.english: We are having a conversation in English.
I want to speak English fluently.

conversation_script.text_en: Hi, what languages do you speak?
That's great. Do you speak Chinese too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。你也会说中文吗？

conversation_script.text_en: A little. I am still learning.
No, but I want to learn French.

conversation_script.text_zh: 法语是一门优美的语言。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you practice English every day?
Yes, I practice with my friends.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我和朋友一起练习。

conversation_script.text_en: How often do you practice English?

conversation_script.text_zh: 你的英语会进步得很快。

sentences.english: My sister is younger than me.
My brother is older than me.
The child is five years old.

conversation_script.text_en: Really? I am eleven years old.
So you are one year older than me.

conversation_script.text_zh: 是的。你的生日是什么时候？

conversation_script.text_en: That's nice. My birthday is in December.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真不错。我的生日在十二月。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have a birthday party?
Yes, we eat cake and play games.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我们吃蛋糕和玩游戏。

sentences.english: I am having a birthday party.
There is a big cake on the table.
Many guests come to my party.
sentences.chinese: 许多客人来参加我的聚会。
每个人都唱生日快乐歌。
我度过了一个美好的生日。

conversation_script.text_en: I am eleven years old now.
Are you having a birthday party?
Yes, my friends are coming this afternoon.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,我的朋友们今天下午会来。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have a birthday cake?
Yes, it is a chocolate cake.
I wish for good health and happiness.
Thank you! Let's enjoy the party.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！让我们享受聚会吧。

sentences.chinese: 让我介绍一下我的朋友。

sentences.english: We have known each other for two years.
My friend speaks English and Chinese.
sentences.chinese: 我的朋友会说英语和中文。
每个人都喜欢我的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi Kevin, this is my friend Sarah.
Hello Sarah, nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too, Kevin.
Really? Which class are you in?
We are in the same English class.
Sarah is very kind and helpful.
conversation_script.text_zh: Sarah非常友善而且乐于助人。

conversation_script.text_en: I'm happy to meet new friends.

sentences.chinese: 你的中文老师在这儿吗？

sentences.english: Is that tall person your friend?
sentences.chinese: 那个高的人是你的朋友吗？

sentences.english: Is the student inside the school now?
sentences.chinese: 现在学生在学校里面吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Hello! Yes, I am a student.
No, he is not a student. He is a teacher.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不是，他不是学生。他是老师。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, is he your Chinese teacher?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，他是你的中文老师吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, he is my Chinese teacher.
Is that girl over there a teacher too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那边的那个女孩也是老师吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, she is a doctor. She is my friend.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不是，她是医生。她是我的朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Is this small cat her cat?
No, that is not her cat.
Do you have a cat or a dog?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你有一只猫还是一条狗？

conversation_script.text_en: I have a big dog. Is that your dog outside?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有一条大狗。外面的那是你的狗吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, that big white dog is mine.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，那条白色的大狗是我的。

conversation_script.text_en: It is very beautiful. Is it friendly?
Yes, it is very good. Let's go outside and see it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，它非常好。我们去外面看看它吧。

sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢的食物是什么？

sentences.english: I am happy because it is my birthday.
sentences.chinese: 我很开心,因为今天是我的生日。

sentences.english: How do you go to school?
I go to school by bus.
WH- questions help us get information.
sentences.chinese: WH问题帮助我们获取信息。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi, can I ask you some questions?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨,我可以问你几个问题吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Because I want to make international friends.
conversation_script.text_zh: 因为我想结交国际朋友。

sentences.chinese: 简短回答让对话更容易。

sentences.english: Can you open the door, please?
Excuse me, where is the library?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,图书馆在哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, can you help me?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,你能帮助我吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Can you tell me where the bus stop is, please?
conversation_script.text_zh: 请问你能告诉我公交车站在哪里吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, there is one across the street.

sentences.english: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,洗手间在哪里？

sentences.english: Excuse me, may I sit here?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,我可以坐这里吗？

sentences.english: Excuse me, can you help me?
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下,你能帮助我吗？
对不起,我忘记你的名字了。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,这个座位有人吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, sorry! I dropped my bag.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦,对不起！我的包掉下来了。

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, what time is it?

conversation_script.text_zh: 对不起,你能再说一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sorry, I need to leave now.

sentences.english: Can you say it more slowly?
How do you pronounce this word?

conversation_script.text_en: Excuse me, what did you say?
conversation_script.text_zh: 打扰一下,你刚才说什么？

conversation_script.text_en: I said my birthday is in September.

conversation_script.text_zh: 对不起,你能重复一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. My birthday is in September.
Thank you. Please speak a little more slowly.
No problem. My birthday is in Sep-tem-ber.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没问题。我的生日在九月。

sentences.english: Can you speak a little louder?
How do you pronounce this word?
Can you spell it for me?
Listening is important when learning English.
sentences.chinese: 学习英语时听力很重要。

conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢的爱好是摄影。
对不起,你能重复一遍吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. My favorite hobby is photography.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。我最喜欢的爱好是摄影。

conversation_script.text_en: Please speak a little more slowly.

conversation_script.text_zh: 我最喜欢的爱好是摄-影。

conversation_script.text_en: It means taking pictures with a camera.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它的意思是用相机拍照。

conversation_script.text_en: I see. How do you pronounce it?
Can you spell it for me?

sentences.english: Can you give me an example?
Can you say that more clearly?
sentences.chinese: 你能说得更清楚一点吗？
练习帮助我更好地理解。

conversation_script.text_en: Today we will learn a new word: 'journey'.
conversation_script.text_zh: 今天我们学习一个新单词: journey。

conversation_script.text_en: No problem. 'Journey' means a trip from one place to another.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没关系。Journey 的意思是从一个地方到另一个地方的旅行。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you give me an example?
Sure. My journey from home to school takes thirty minutes.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。我从家到学校的路程需要三十分钟。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you say that more slowly?
Of course. It means it needs time.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。它的意思是需要时间。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! Do you have another question?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！你还有别的问题吗？

conversation_script.text_en: I will. Thank you for your help.

sentences.chinese: 让我介绍一下我的同学。

sentences.english: Today is my first day here.
sentences.chinese: 今天是我来这里的第一天。

sentences.english: I am happy to meet new people.
He greeted everyone with a smile.
We shook hands and introduced ourselves.
sentences.chinese: 我们握手并做了自我介绍。

sentences.english: It was a pleasure meeting you.
I hope we can be friends.
sentences.chinese: 我希望我们能成为朋友。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, today is my first day.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的,今天是我的第一天。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. My name is Kevin.
Nice to meet you too, Sarah.
That's wonderful. I have never been there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。我从没去过那里。

conversation_script.text_en: Maybe you can visit one day.
conversation_script.text_zh: 也许有一天你可以去看看。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you have many students in this class?

sentences.english: I wake up early in the morning.
We have lunch in the afternoon.
I study English in the evening.
I go to sleep at night.
The sun rises in the morning.
The sun sets in the evening.
Good morning! How are you today?
Good afternoon! Nice to see you again.
sentences.chinese: 下午好！很高兴再次见到你。

conversation_script.text_en: I'm great, thank you. And you?
What time do your classes start?
They start at eight o'clock in the morning.
Good afternoon, Sarah. How was your day?
conversation_script.text_zh: 下午好,Sarah。你今天过得怎么样？

conversation_script.text_en: What do you do in the evening?
I study English and read books.
Good night, Sarah. See you tomorrow.

sentences.english: I speak English, French, and Chinese.
sentences.chinese: 我会说英语、法语和中文。
我最喜欢的爱好是阅读。
我很友好并且乐于助人。

sentences.english: This is some information about me.
sentences.chinese: 这是一些关于我的信息。

sentences.english: A short introduction is easy to remember.
sentences.chinese: 简短的自我介绍容易记住。

sentences.english: Five sentences are enough for a basic introduction.
sentences.chinese: 五句话足够完成一个基础自我介绍。

conversation_script.text_en: Hello everyone. Let me introduce myself.
conversation_script.text_zh: 大家好。让我介绍一下自己。

conversation_script.text_en: I speak English, French, and Chinese.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会说英语、法语和中文。
这是一个很好的自我介绍。

conversation_script.text_en: How long have you been learning English?
I have been learning English for two years.
I want to improve my speaking skills.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想提高我的口语能力。

conversation_script.text_en: I will. Thank you for listening.
